raw_segments.text: And so Porfiry himself had explained it to Razumihin, had explained it psychologically.
He had begun bringing in his damned psychology again, Porfiry.
But to think that Porfiry should for one moment believe that Nikolay was guilty, after what
had passed between them before Nikolay's appearance, after that ter-tater interview,
which could have only one explanation.
During those days Raskolnikov had often recalled passages in that scene with Porfiry.
He could not bear to let his mind rest on it.
Such words, such gestures had passed between them.
Things had been said in such a tone and had reached such a pass that Nikolay, whom Porfiry
had seen through at the first word, at the first gesture, could not have shaken his conviction.
